messages:
mei chen: Quick heads-up — brought up orion-v3 (q5) on canary and seeing a quality regression on the multilingual bench. Overall BLEU down ~1.2, but huge hits for Tibetan+Devanagari mixed inputs (~-4 BLEU) and an odd Hebrew/RTL numeral mirroring issue. eval-bot posted the artifact link :eyes: 
akshay patel: Can you paste a minimal example that shows the numeral mirroring? Also any tokenization diffs? 
mei chen: Minimal repro below — note the digits reversed in hypothesis vs ref for the hebrew example:
```
ref: הוא קיבל 12345 כפרס
hyp: הוא קיבל 54321 כפרס
```
mei chen: For Tibetan/devanagari mix here's an example where segments glue incorrectly and subtokens shift: 
```
ref: བོད་ཡིག + हिन्दी
hyp: བོདयाིག+ हिन्दी
```
li wei: I reproduced locally: `./bin/run_eval --model orion-v3 --quant q5 --testset multilingual/mix-2026 --locales tib,nep,he` -> tib BLEU -3.9, nep -2.1, he numeral mirror reproduced. Logs: `logs/orionv3_q5/mix-2026/*.json` 
marta gonzalez: My hunch: tokenizer change + quant runtime kernel reorder. There's a tokenizer commit (ab12cd3) that tweaked script-switching and a kernel update (5f2e1b9) that changes buffer packing; either could cause subtle boundary or shaping regressions. :thinking: 
akshay patel: Starting bisect on tokenization changes first (cheaper). If that's clean I'll run kernel bisect. 
deploy-bot: Canary deploy orion-v3-q5-canary reverted to q4 at 2026-03-20T18:22Z after alerting regression monitors :thumbsup: 
eval-bot: Quick summary artifact: s3://redwood-evals/orionv3-q5/multilang/mix-2026/compare.html. Metrics: overall BLEU -1.21, chrF -0.012; tib -4.07, nep -2.13, he numeral-mirror count=18/120 failed examples. Diffs attached. 
li wei: Quick local mitigation worked: enabling legacy script-switch mode in tokenizer flags reduced tib delta to -0.6 in smoke (`--allow-script-switch=false`). Command used: 
```
REDWOOD_EVAL_TOKENIZER_FLAGS="--allow-script-switch=false" ./run_eval --model orion-v3 --quant q5 --testset multilingual/mix-2026 --locales tib,he
```
mei chen: That mitigation helps Thai/Tibetan mixing in smoke but doesn't fix hebrew numeral shaping — looks like shaping/mirroring happens after tokenization (render-time or postprocess). Filed RED-3214 with reproducer artifacts and failing pairs. 
marta gonzalez: Adding a regression test to CI that runs the failing hebrew-numeral and tib-dev mix cases under quantized builds and flags any chrF/BLEU drop >1.5 for locale-specific suites. :white_check_mark: 
akshay patel: Once bisect confirms root cause (tokenizer vs kernel), we'll decide revert vs targeted patch+test. Thanks for quick triage — ping me if you want me to own the rollback or the patch. :pray:
